must_fix.title: Escape in a nested Dialog also closes every enclosing Dialog
must_fix.evidence: Dialog.tsx:49-51 calls onOpenChange(false) on Escape without event.stopPropagation(); React passes portal events up to the parent component, so the outer Dialog's onKeyDown also fires. Probe test (outer Dialog open, a button inside opens an inner Dialog, focus on 'inner btn', user.keyboard('{Escape}')), run with `npx vitest run src/zzprobe`, printed `focus: inner btn dialogs: 2` then `after Escape dialogs open: 0 focus: open outer`. Only the inner dialog should close. The Combobox already stops propagation on Escape for exactly this reason, and the README documents it.

must_fix.title: Focus trap breaks after a mouse press on the backdrop
must_fix.evidence: The backdrop div (Dialog.tsx:98-102) cannot take focus, so a press on it sends focus to <body>. The trap only handles Tab keydown inside the content (Dialog.tsx:48-73); there is no focusin guard and nothing on mousedown pulls focus back. Probe: <button>outside</button><Dialog open onOpenChange={() => {}}>...</Dialog>, user.click(backdrop), then user.tab(): printed `after refused backdrop click focus: BODY` / `then Tab: outside`. Pressing on the backdrop and releasing inside the content (the dialog stays open, as the README promises) printed `after drag focus: BODY` / `after tab focus: BUTTON outside`. After that, Escape no longer closes the dialog either. The issue requires focus to be trapped inside; no test covers focus after a backdrop press.

nits: The Combobox 'No results' role=status element is mounted together with its text, so screen readers may not announce it; keep an empty live region mounted.
Combobox option ids and keys come from the array index, so reordering options moves aria-activedescendant to a different option; use the option value instead.
The Tabs arrow, Home and End handling ignores modifier keys, so Alt+ArrowLeft and similar are swallowed instead of reaching the browser.
A Tab is selected on click even when the consumer's onClick calls preventDefault().
The Dialog TABBABLE selector misses [contenteditable], summary and audio/video[controls], and only checks for a [hidden] ancestor, not CSS-hidden elements.
Opening the Combobox does not make the currently selected option the active one.

report:
I wouldn't merge this yet. `pnpm test` passes (56 tests), `pnpm typecheck` is clean, and Tabs and Combobox did what the issue asks in my probes. The Dialog has two confirmed bugs, both in focus handling.

I checked each by temporarily adding `src/zzprobe/probe.test.tsx`, running `npx vitest run src/zzprobe`, then deleting it. `git status` is back exactly as I found it.

### Must fix

**1. Escape in a nested Dialog closes every Dialog around it.** `Dialog.tsx:49-51` calls `onOpenChange(false)` but doesn't stop the event. React passes events from a portal up to the parent component, so the outer Dialog's `onKeyDown` gets the same Escape.
- Probe: outer Dialog is open, a button inside it opens an inner Dialog, focus is on "inner btn", then Escape.
- Output: `focus: inner btn dialogs: 2` → `after Escape dialogs open: 0 focus: open outer`
- Only the inner one should close. The contributor already knew about this propagation path: the Combobox calls `stopPropagation` on Escape so a surrounding Dialog stays open, and the README documents that. The Dialog's own handler doesn't do the same.

**2. The focus trap breaks after a mouse press on the backdrop.** The backdrop `<div>` can't take focus, so pressing on it sends focus to `<body>`. The trap only handles Tab keydown events inside the dialog content (`Dialog.tsx:48-73`). There's no `focusin` guard and nothing on mousedown pulls focus back, so after that Tab leaves the dialog and Escape no longer works. The issue says focus must be trapped inside.
- Probe A: the consumer ignores backdrop clicks (`onOpenChange={() => {}}`), then the user clicks the backdrop and presses Tab.
  - Output: `after refused backdrop click focus: BODY`, `then Tab: outside`
- Probe B: the user presses on the backdrop and releases inside the content. The dialog stays open, which the README promises.
  - Output: `after drag focus: BODY`, `after tab focus: BUTTON outside`
- No test covers focus after a backdrop press.

### Nits (not blocking)
- **No Results message:** the "No results" `role="status"` element is mounted at the same moment as its text. Screen readers often skip announcing a live region that appears already filled; keeping an empty region mounted would fix that.
- **Combobox ids:** option ids are built from the array index (`option-${index}`), so if `options` is reordered, `aria-activedescendant` and the React keys move to different options. Using the option value would avoid that.
- **Tab arrow keys:** they ignore modifier keys, so for example Alt+ArrowLeft is swallowed instead of going to the browser.
- **Tab click:** the tab is selected even if the consumer's `onClick` called `preventDefault()`.
- **Dialog tabbable selector:** it misses `[contenteditable]`, `summary` and `audio/video[controls]`, and only checks for a `[hidden]` ancestor, not for elements hidden with CSS.
- **Combobox on open:** opening the list doesn't make the currently selected option the active one.
